symbols.name: TheCartIsSaved
symbols.signature: [StepDefinition(@"the cart is saved")] public void TheCartIsSaved() => cart.Save()

symbols.signature: [Then(@"the cart holds (\d+) items")] public void ThenTheCartHolds(int count) => Assert.Equal(count, cart.Count)
